prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 1440x1000 landscape
Primary request: Design the executive dashboard first viewport for a Thai university planning, budget, project, disbursement, and quality KPI system. The visual world is an evidence matrix wall: gaps between budgets, project delivery, quarterly evidence, EdPEx and AUN-QA KPIs become visible and actionable immediately.
Composition/framing: precise left navigation as criterion labels, compact top action strip, dominant central matrix with rows for units/projects and columns for คำของบ, อนุมัติ, ผลดำเนินงาน, เบิกจ่าย, KPI, หลักฐาน. Matrix cells use purposeful symbols, values, and status labels; selecting one cell opens a slim evidence inspector without losing the full matrix. Include a compact decision queue above the matrix rather than generic metric cards.
Style/medium: polished production-ready SaaS UI mockup, systematic evidence tags, cross-reference rules, crisp typography, high information density, flat surfaces.
Color palette: vivid orange #EA580C, soft orange #FFEDD5, white #FFFFFF, warm gray #FAFAF9, ink #1C1917, restrained teal #0F766E, red only for risk.
Materials/textures: reference matrix, criterion tabs, evidence pins translated into digital UI; no literal cork board and no paper texture.
Text (verbatim where legible): ระบบบริหารแผน, ผนังหลักฐาน, ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง, รายการที่ต้องตัดสินใจ, คำของบ, อนุมัติ, ดำเนินงาน, เบิกจ่าย, KPI, หลักฐาน, ปีงบประมาณ 2570, EdPEx, AUN-QA.
Constraints: Thai-first; role-aware executive view; tabular numerals; accessible contrast; data dense but scanable; clear text labels plus color; no logo invention; no browser chrome.
Avoid: generic four KPI cards, conventional dashboard chart mosaic, glassmorphism, gradients, huge rounded cards, purple/blue branding, decorative illustrations, excessive pills, dark mode.
